limitations: A fixed local synthetic diagnostic with two sequential native followups; this is not a complete external channel or continuous core loop.
Context receipt proves the authorized data entered the native user/message durably and the control cursor was acknowledged; it does not prove model understanding of every field.
Event delivery ack is separate from context ack; native receipts and exact message hashes/seq support this case.
Same-session marker reuse is a hot Session observation; no post-restart followup, business compaction or crash recovery is validated.
Two requested rounds are not an account-wide call/fee total. Two native completed calls are observable here; provider transport retry count and monetary cost are unknown.
First-round cacheRead/cacheWrite fields were absent; second-round cacheRead 384 was explicitly reported. Missing fields are not zero.
Full UI 112 passed before final attempts-label change; final affected context suite 30 passed, not a claimed full run of all 113 registered tests.
Original six Session files were hashed without re-decoding; new Session was decoded across all concatenated zstd frames. Prompts and reply bodies are omitted.
Reload was an orderly runtime-plugin disable/enable, with no subsequent followup or explicit resume; it validates preservation and lack of replay, not post-restart generation or crash recovery.
The independent post-run snapshot followed the root read-only UI refresh. The refresh 40-to-40 watermark observation is root-recorded; no separate earlier independent snapshot is invented.
Both operation/draft records retain ready as a historical outcome. This is not a claim that the generation-4 draft remains current or may be delivered after generation 5. No delivery was attempted.
